gen-press-start-2p-fs-chillax: Relaxed and retro: Press Start 2P pins cut-out letters far apart. Chillax, a sans-serif with loose spaghetti-like lines and curves left unfinished, would carry paragraph after paragraph in an easygoing, unhurried way.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-basic: Cut-out letters pinned far apart, with a lightly engraved look. Press Start 2P handles the fun, retro flash, while Basic keeps to a gentle bump from small letters to capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-days-one: Fun and retro at a glance, with cut-out letters pinned far apart in Press Start 2P. And Days One fills the line with a high x-height, spaced like rope-ladder rungs.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-epunda-sans: Cut-out letters pinned far apart: that is Press Start 2P at its best. Epunda Sans does the reverse, with sidebearings trimmed thin and oversized counters full of daylight inside every curve.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-farro: Retro cut-out letters, pinned far apart, in Press Start 2P. What stands out is Farro, a sans-serif of wire-bent letters with no stroke contrast, sitting under that jumpy heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-genos: Fun first: Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart. Genos, a plain sans with tightly pressed glyphs and a high midline, handles the steady reading, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-jaldi: Jaldi is a sans with an x-height pushed well above the usual and a visibly gaping c at any size. Press Start 2P does the retro fun, with thins that never turn spindly.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Cut-out letters pinned far apart give Press Start 2P its look. Kdam Thmor Pro, a contemporary sans with bowls that fill the line, would carry text smoothly from one paragraph to the next.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-menbere: Fun at first sight, Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart. Menbere, its lowercase stacked tall like rolled cord, keeps text moving with a clean, tidy rhythm.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-secular-one: Cut-out letters, pinned far apart, make the first impression. Press Start 2P adds a mellow shift between heavy and light strokes, while Secular One swallows the line's height with flat, contrast-free letters.
